description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Let's Go]

You and all allies within 60 feet gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened] condition. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

If the origin has the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Supersonic Speed] feat, you gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed]{Concealment} until the start of your next turn if you Stride while quickened from Let's Go. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to Hide.
